blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Remote sensing scene understanding requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to interpret queried targets in relation to nearby objects and surrounding structures, which serve as spatial references or define the scope of an answer. However, standard answers and bounding boxes often leave these contextual relationships implicit. Thus, we construct GeoContext-5K to make them explicit in 5,394 training pairs for visual question answering (VQA), with spatial cues, visual facts, and supporting regions. GeOPD uses these annotations for on-policy distillation, guiding a frozen teacher with region marks on the full image and a visual fact while preserving surrounding spatial references. It prioritizes teacher corrections that agree with the shift in the student's next token distribution when evidence is restored. A complementary objective weights the contrast between the student's scores on the two views by how much masking lowers the teacher's log probability for the same sampled token. Experiments on five remote sensing VQA benchmarks show that GeOPD outperforms the evaluated open-source MLLMs and matched post-training baselines, improving over the 4B and 9B base models by 5.81 and 2.97 percentage points on average. The dataset and code will be publicly released at https://github.com/YeeCharm/GeOPD.
blocks.zh: 遥感场景理解要求多模式大型语言模型(MLLMs)对所询问的目标与相邻的物体和周围结构进行解释,作为空间参考或界定答案的范围. 然而,标准答案和边框往往使这些背景关系隐含. 因此,我们构建了GeoContext-5K,在5,394个可进行视觉问答的训练对中明确它们,并附有空间提示、视觉事实和支持区域。 GeOPD使用这些说明进行政策分解,指导被冷冻的老师在保存周围空间参考物的同时,在全图像和视觉事实上带有区域标记. 它优先考虑那些同意学生在证据被恢复后下一个符号分配的转变的教师矫正. 一个互补的客观权衡了学生在两种观点上的分数对比,通过遮掩多少降低了老师对同一被采样的令牌的日志概率. 关于5个遥感VQA基准的实验表明,GeOPD的绩效超过了评估的开源MLLM,并匹配了培训后的基线,比4B和9B的基准模型平均提高了5.81和2.97个百分点. 数据集和代码将在https://github.com/YeeCharm/GeOPD上公开发布.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Scene context determines what counts as evidence. Three examples compare VAD, RS-OPSD, and GeOPD on target selection, counting within a specified region, and reasoning from landmarks. The annotations and crops identify evidence for each question within its scene.
blocks.zh: 图1:场景背景决定什么是证据。 三个实例比较了VAD、RS-OPSD和GeOPD关于目标选择,在指定区域内计数,以及从地标推理。 说明和收成为每个问题都提供了证据。

blocks.en: Remote sensing scene understanding involves recognizing objects, interpreting spatial relations, and characterizing larger regions [ 23 , 40 ] . In wide aerial scenes where similar objects recur [ 38 ] , MLLMs must interpret the scene in relation to the question, using nearby landmarks to identify the intended instance and surrounding structures to define the scope of spatially constrained tasks ( e.g. , the parking lot and diagonal road in Figure 1 delimit the area in which the white blocks are counted). The query thus determines which scene elements must be interpreted jointly.
blocks.zh: 遥感场景理解涉及识别物体、解释空间关系并描述更大的区域[23、40]。 在类似物体重现的广阔空中场景[38]中,MLLM必须结合问题解释场景,用相邻的地标来识别预定实例和周围结构来定义空间受限任务的范围(例如图1中的停车场和对角道来划分白块被计数的区域). 因此,查询决定了哪些场景要素必须共同解释。

blocks.en: Existing MLLMs often fail in such scenes when fine details and contextual cues are not effectively grounded. Prior work improves detail access via cropping and multi-view inspection [ 21 , 49 , 13 ] , yet tight crops often discard the external landmarks or boundaries needed to interpret a target, whereas full images leave relevant context unguided. Moreover, standard answer supervision and bounding boxes [ 12 , 17 ] rarely distinguish the target, the spatial reference, and the visual relation linking them.
blocks.zh: 现有的MLLM在细节和背景提示没有有效根据的情况下往往在这样的场景中失败. 以往的工作通过收割和多视图检查[21、49、13]改进了详细获取情况,但收紧的作物往往丢弃解释目标所需的外部地标或界限,而完整的图像则使相关背景得不到指导。 此外,标准答案监督和边框[12,17]很少区分目标,空间参考,以及将目标联系起来的视觉关系.

blocks.en: Thus, we construct GeoContext-5K, a dataset of 5,394 training QA pairs (2,658 multiple-choice and 2,736 short-answer questions) across six task families, including region-bounded counting, spatial relations, and attribute comparisons. Each record provides a spatial cue indicating where to look, a visual fact describing what is visible, and grounding boxes distinguishing target evidence from spatial references. Drawing on VRSBench [ 17 ] , LRS-GRO [ 21 ] , and RS5M [ 54 ] , these structured annotations let us anchor the teacher on the full scene while selectively occluding target evidence, preserving the surrounding landmarks and spatial boundaries required to resolve the query.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们构建了GeoContext-5K,一个由5,394个培训QA对(2,658个多选择和2,736个短答问题)组成的数据集,涉及6个任务家庭,包括区域范围计数、空间关系和属性比较。 每一份记录都提供了一个空间提示,说明何处可以看,一个描述可见事物的可视事实,以及将目标证据与空间参考区分开来地标框. 利用VRS Bench [17],LRS-GRO [21],以及RS5M [54],这些结构化的说明让我们将老师固定在全场,同时有选择地占用目标证据,保存周边地标和解决查询所需的空间界限.

blocks.en: Building on this foundation, we further propose GeOPD, an on-policy distillation (OPD) framework that transfers contextual reasoning from a privileged teacher to the student’s next-token predictions [ 1 ] . Unlike crop-based or multi-view OPD strategies [ 13 , 49 , 52 ] , our frozen teacher receives a visual fact and the full scene with the target and reference regions marked, preserving the global layout. To assess the visual support for teacher corrections, we measure the shift in the student’s next token distribution from the target-masked to the original view, holding the question and response prefix fixed. Corrections that align more closely with this shift receive greater weight in distillation.
blocks.zh: 在这个基础上,我们进一步提出了GeOPD,一个政策提炼(OPD)框架,将背景推理从一位特权教师转移到学生的下一个预测[1]. 与以作物为主或多视图的OPD策略[13,49,52]不同,被冻结的老师得到一个可视事实和完整的场景,并标出目标和参考区域,保持了全球布局. 校对:Soup 与这种转变更加相适应的教养在蒸馏中受到更大的分量。

blocks.en: To ensure the student actively relies on the target evidence rather than language priors, we introduce a visual contrast objective that compares its scores on the original and masked views. The frozen teacher scores the same sampled token on both views using only the corresponding image, question, and shared prefix. A larger drop in the teacher’s log probability under masking gives more weight to reinforcing the student’s existing score advantage on the original view. We combine this contrast loss with directionally weighted distillation, updating the student solely through the original image branch.
blocks.zh: 为了确保学生积极依靠目标证据而不是语言前科,我们引入了一个视觉对比目标,将其分数与原始和被掩盖的观点进行比较. 被冻结的老师只使用相应的图像,提问和共享前缀,在两种观点上对相同的被抽样的符号进行评分. 在遮掩下教师的日志概率下降幅度更大,使学生在原有观点上巩固现有分数优势更加重要。 我们把这种对比性损失与方向加权分馏结合起来,仅仅通过原始图像分支更新学生.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We construct GeoContext-5K, a remote sensing dataset that explicitly disentangles target evidence from spatial references via spatial cues, atomic visual facts, and role-specific boxes across 5,394 verified pairs. • We propose GeOPD to distill full-scene contextual evidence by weighting distribution matching via student visual alignment and calibrating cross-view contrast via teacher masking sensitivity. • Across five remote sensing VQA benchmarks, GeOPD leads all post-training baselines at 4B (63.80%) and 9B (64.98%), with our 4B student surpassing the 9B base model by 1.79 points.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 我们建造了GeoContext-5K,这是一个遥感数据集,通过空间提示、原子视觉事实和特定角色的盒子,将目标证据从空间参考中明确区分开来,跨越5 394个经核实的对子。 我们建议GeOPD通过学生视觉对齐的加权分布比对和通过教师的遮掩敏感性校正交叉视图对比来提炼全景背景证据. • 在5个遥感VQA基准中,GeOPD在4B(63.80%)和9B(64.98%)领先所有培训后基线,我们的4B学生比9B基准模型高出1.79分。

blocks.en: We construct GeoContext-5K, a remote sensing dataset that explicitly disentangles target evidence from spatial references via spatial cues, atomic visual facts, and role-specific boxes across 5,394 verified pairs.
blocks.zh: 我们构建了GeoContext-5K,这是一个遥感数据集,通过空间提示、原子视觉事实和特定角色的盒子,将目标证据从空间参考物中明确区分开来,跨越5,394个经核实的对子.

blocks.en: We propose GeOPD to distill full-scene contextual evidence by weighting distribution matching via student visual alignment and calibrating cross-view contrast via teacher masking sensitivity.
blocks.zh: 我们建议GeOPD通过学生视觉对齐的加权分布比对和通过教师遮掩敏感度校正交叉视图对比来提炼全景背景证据.

blocks.en: Across five remote sensing VQA benchmarks, GeOPD leads all post-training baselines at 4B (63.80%) and 9B (64.98%), with our 4B student surpassing the 9B base model by 1.79 points.
blocks.zh: 在五个遥感VQA基准中,GeOPD在4B(63.80%)和9B(64.98%)领先所有培训后基线,我们的4B学生比9B基准模型高出1.79分。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Context in Remote Sensing Understanding
blocks.zh: 2.1 遥感了解的背景

blocks.en: The surrounding layout helps resolve ambiguity in remote sensing imagery ( e.g. , identifying a runway from the taxiways that connect it to an apron). Existing models span scene description, VQA, and visual grounding [ 14 , 28 , 17 , 45 , 31 ] . ZoomEarth [ 21 ] selects regions from a scene overview for closer inspection, GeoViS [ 53 ] refines localization via hierarchical search, and recent work grounds intermediate reasoning in visible regions [ 19 ] . While localization and zooming expose local details, the roles of surrounding landmarks or boundaries remain implicit, motivating supervision that specifies how target evidence and spatial context jointly support an answer.
blocks.zh: 周边布局有助于解决遥感图像中的模糊性(例如,从滑行道上找出一条连接到停机坪的跑道). 现有模型横跨场景描述,VQA,并可视化地取地 [14,28,17,45,31]. ZoomEarth [21] 从场景概览中选择区域进行更仔细的检查,GeoViS [53]通过分级搜索改进了本地化,以及近期在可见区域的工作场中间推理 [19]. 虽然本地化和放大暴露出地方细节,但周边地标或边界的作用仍然隐含着,促使监督明确目标证据和空间背景如何共同支持答案。

blocks.en: 2.2 Privileged On-Policy Distillation
blocks.zh: 2.2 政策消化

blocks.en: On-policy distillation supervises the student along its own sampled trajectories [ 9 , 1 ] , with privileged variants augmenting teacher inputs during training. Vision-OPD [ 49 ] supplies an evidence-centered crop, RP-OPSD [ 55 ] feeds native resolution images to the teacher and RS-OPSD [ 13 ] combines global, contextual, and detailed views. Textual guidance offers another form of privilege through spatial hints, cues recoverable from the image, or observations drawn from student trajectories [ 35 , 37 , 43 ] . However, teacher corrections may reflect cropping artifacts [ 11 ] or ungrounded text priors, leaving open which corrections reflect evidence visible to the student.
blocks.zh: 政策分解监督学生按照自己取样的轨迹[9, 1],特殊变体在培训期间增加教师投入。 Vision-OPD [49] 提供以证据为中心的作物,RP-OPSD [55] 向教师提供本地分辨率图像,RS-OPSD [13] 结合了全球、背景和详细观点。 文字指导通过空间提示、可从图像中恢复的提示或从学生轨迹中得出的观测结果,提供另一种形式的特权[35、37、43]。 但是,教师的校正可能反映裁剪文物[11]或无根据的文本前科,留下未打开的校正反映学生可见的证据.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Overview of GeoContext-5K construction. The annotation pipeline comprises three stages covering source and task selection, joint construction of QA pairs and supporting evidence, and record verification. An independent model reviews the resulting records, and human reviewers inspect a subset.
blocks.zh: 图2:GeoContext-5K建筑概况. 注释管道包括三个阶段,包括源和任务选择、联合建造质量保证对和辅助证据以及记录核查。 一个独立模式审查由此产生的记录,而人文审查者审查一个子集。

blocks.en: 2.3 Distillation with Visual Evidence
blocks.zh: 2.3 有视觉证据的蒸发

blocks.en: Counterfactual visual perturbations offer a principled mechanism to probe how model predictions rely on specific visual evidence [ 26 , 15 ] , serving as an effective vehicle to refine teacher supervision during distillation [ 29 , 39 , 7 , 46 ] . Along this line, VA-OPD [ 20 ] reweights distillation by detail sensitivity, VAD [ 52 ] reconstructs targets via visual attribution, EAD [ 11 ] aligns teacher corrections with student shifts under evidence restoration, and S-OPD [ 22 ] calibrates cross-view student contrast via teacher masking drops. Despite their effectiveness, these approaches typically treat visual evidence monolithically, overlooking the interplay between target instances and surrounding spatial context. In this work, we leverage question-specific scene annotations to anchor a full-scene teacher while explicitly decoupling target object masks from spatial references, providing fine-grained, disentangled supervision for both objectives.
blocks.zh: 反事实视觉扰动提供了一个原则机制来探究模型预测如何依靠具体的视觉证据[26,15],作为在分馏过程中完善教师监督的有效工具[29,39,7,46]. 沿着这条线,VA-OPD[20]再通过细节敏感性来进行分馏,VAD[52]通过视觉归属来重建目标,EAD[11]在证据修复下将教师的校正与学生的班次相协调,而S-OPD[22]通过教师口罩滴来校正跨视学生的对比. 尽管这些方法很有效,但这些方法通常单从视觉证据的角度对待,忽略了目标实例与周围空间背景之间的相互作用。 在这部作品中,我们利用特定的问题场景说明来锁定一名全场教师,同时明确将目标物体口罩与空间参考物脱钩,为两个目标提供精细分明的监管.

blocks.en: 3 GeoContext-5K Dataset
blocks.zh: 3 个 GeoContext-5K 数据集

blocks.en: Existing remote sensing VQA and grounding datasets [ 17 , 21 ] rarely make explicit how surrounding landmarks and boundaries support individual answers. We construct GeoContext-5K via the three-stage pipeline in Figure 2 to link queries and answers to their target evidence and spatial references in the full scene (see Appendix A for dataset comparisons and review criteria).
blocks.zh: 现有的遥感VQA和地基数据集[17,21]很少明确说明周边地标和边界如何支持个人答案. 我们通过图2中的三相管道构建了GeoContext-5K,将查询和答复与整个场景中的目标证据和空间参考联系起来(数据集比较和审查标准见附录A)。

blocks.en: Stage 1. Sources and Tasks. GeoContext-5K draws on imagery and available annotations from VRSBench [ 17 ] , LRS-GRO [ 21 ] , and RS5M [ 54 ] . The source image is the unit of sampling, and each candidate retains the full scene together with any available descriptions and region annotations. Task selection reflects what is visible at the scale of the intended question, from a target and its spatial references to the layout of a wider region. The six task families cover counting, existence and negation, spatial relations, attributes and comparisons, regional extent and boundaries, and scenes and land cover.
blocks.zh: 阶段 1. 来源和任务。 GeoContext-5K取自VRS Bench [17],LRS-GRO [21],以及RS5M [54]的图像和现有说明. 源图像是采样单位,每个候选人保留了完整的场景以及任何可用的描述和地区说明. 任务选择反映了从目标及其空间参考到更广泛的区域布局等在预定问题的规模上可见的内容。 六个任务家庭包括计数、存在和否定、空间关系、属性和比较、区域范围和边界、场景和土地覆盖。

blocks.en: Stage 2. Grounded QA and Evidence. We use GPT-6.1 Sol [ 27 ] to construct QA pairs, with the procedure depending on whether a suitable question is already available. We retain or revise source questions that support a definite answer from the image, or draft new QA pairs otherwise. To eliminate referential ambiguity, spatial relation queries explicitly specify the interacting entities, whereas counting queries strictly define both the target category unit and the spatial search scope, with all instances formatted as concise short-answer or multiple-choice items. For fine-grained supervision, each data record couples the question–answer pair with structured multi-level annotations: (i) a textual spatial cue that designates the target entity, reference anchor, or search region; (ii) an atomic visual fact articulating the underlying observational evidence; and (iii) precise bounding boxes that separately localize the target evidence and its corresponding spatial references ( e.g. , the running track in Figure 2 locates the reference field for the tennis court question and is itself the target feature to identify in the question about the field’s perimeter).
blocks.zh: 阶段 2. 有根据的质量保证和证据。 我们使用GPT-6.1 Sol [27] 来构建QA对,其程序取决于是否已具备合适的问题. 我们保留或修改支持图像明确答案的来源问题,或起草新的质量保证对等文件。 为消除偏好模糊,空间关系查询明确指定了相互作用的实体,而计数查询则严格定义了目标类别单位和空间搜索范围,所有实例都格式化为简洁的短答或多选项. 对于精细的监管,每个数据记录对等的回答和结构化的多层次说明:(一) 指定目标实体、参考锚地或搜索区域的文字空间提示;(二) 阐明基本观测证据的原子视觉事实;以及(三) 将目标证据及其相应空间参考物分别定位的精确边框(例如图2中的跑道为网球场问题的参考地段定位,其本身是问题中确定球场周边目标特征)。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Overview of GeOPD. Left: The student samples a response on the original image. At each prefix, it predicts from the original and masked views, and the teacher from the marked view with a visual fact. Right: Agreement between teacher corrections and the student’s response to restored evidence weights distillation. The frozen teacher’s score drop under masking scales contrast for the sampled token. Both losses backpropagate through the original image branch. For the single sample shown, we omit the response index i i .
blocks.zh: 图3:GeOPD概览. 左边 : 学生在原相上取出一个响应. 在每个前缀中,它都从原始和被遮掩的视角来预测,而从被标记的视角来预测教师带有可视事实. 右: 教师校正与学生对恢复证据权重反应的协议. 被冻结的老师的分数 与被抽取的代币相比, 两者都通过原始图像分支失去后通口. 对于所显示的单一样本,我们省略了反应指数i.

blocks.en: Stage 3. Review and Verification. To verify that the answers and annotations are supported by the scene, an independent model first answers from the unmarked image and the question alone. It then compares its response with the reference answer and checks that the referent and scope are clear, the stated facts are visible, and the boxes cover the described evidence. Following human spot-checks, we revise ambiguous records and discard unverifiable ones. The final GeoContext-5K dataset contains 5,394 verified training QA pairs, comprising 2,658 multiple-choice questions and 2,736 short-answer questions, with dual-tier perceptual hash and feature similarity checks screening for potential visual overlaps against downstream evaluation benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 阶段 3. 审查和核查。 为了验证答案和说明得到场景的支持,一个独立模型首先从无标记的图像中解答,而仅从问题中解答. 然后,它将答复与参考答复和检查进行比较,这些答复和检查表明,说明的内容和范围是清楚的,所陈述的事实是显而易见的,方框包括所陈述的证据。 经过人类现场检查,我们修改了模棱两可的记录,抛弃了无法核实的记录。 最终的GeoContext-5K数据集包含5 394个经核实的训练QA对,包括2 658个多选择问题和2 736个短答问题,具有双重认知散列,并具有类似性检查功能,对照下游评价基准筛选可能的视觉重叠.

blocks.en: 4 GeOPD
blocks.zh: 4个GEOPD

blocks.en: Building on GeoContext-5K, GeOPD uses the evidence annotated for each question to guide the teacher within the full scene and to isolate target evidence from spatial references for counterfactual masking. These annotations support two training objectives in Figure 3 . Directional distillation upweights teacher corrections aligned with the student’s response to restoring target evidence, while visual contrast uses teacher masking sensitivity to reinforce the student’s original-view score.
blocks.zh: 在GeoContext-5K的基础上,GeOPD利用每个题注上所标注的证据来指导整个场景内的老师,并将目标证据从空间引用中分离出来,用于反事实的遮掩. 这些说明支持图3中的两个培训目标。 定向分馏提升了教师的校正与学生对恢复目标证据的反应一致,而视觉对比则利用教师的遮掩敏感性来强化学生的原景分数.

blocks.en: 4.1 Contextual Evidence for Supervision
blocks.zh: 4.1 监督的背景证据

blocks.en:
To guide the teacher while preserving surrounding context, we mark supporting regions on the full image. In Figure 3 , the box highlights the queried roof, and the visual fact locates the hangar relative to the paved lane. Combining the marked view I box I_{\mathrm{box}} of image I I with question q q and visual fact e fact e_{\mathrm{fact}} gives the privileged context c T = ( I box , q , e fact ) c^{T}=(I_{\mathrm{box}},q,e_{\mathrm{fact}}) . While I box I_{\mathrm{box}} marks both target and reference regions to anchor the teacher, we construct I mask I_{\mathrm{mask}} by filling only target evidence pixels in I I with the scene’s mean RGB color to avoid black-box artifacts. Crucially, surrounding landmarks, search boundaries, and any reference regions overlapping or nested within the target box ( e.g. , the inner field within the running track in Figure 2 ) remain unoccluded, isolating the visibility of the queried target.
For each rollout, the student π θ \pi_{\theta} samples a response y y from the original image and question. Scoring along that response keeps the generated text fixed across views. blocks.en: Training setup. We train Qwen3.5-4B/9B [ 30 ] with GeOPD using 5,394 questions from GeoContext-5K. Directional distillation uses Jensen–Shannon (JS) divergence with a mixture coefficient of 0.5. We compute it over the 100 tokens ranked highest by the student on the original image and a single bucket for the remaining probability mass. The teacher stays frozen at the student’s initial checkpoint, and the visual contrast coefficient is λ = 0.02 \lambda=0.02 . The 4B OPD runs use one epoch, batches of 96 questions, four responses per question, and a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} . We train GeOPD for 56 optimization steps at both backbone sizes.

blocks.en: Comparison with post-training methods. In Table 2 , GeOPD achieves the highest average score at both scales, surpassing SFT by 1.68 points at 4B and 0.98 at 9B, with wider margins over GRPO. At 4B, GeOPD consistently outperforms SFT across both the four multiple-choice benchmarks (+1.55 points on average) and open-ended HRVQA (+2.25 points). At 9B, where base multiple-choice scores saturate via option heuristics, GeOPD retains the leading multiple-choice average while surpassing SFT by 4.35 points on open-ended HRVQA. Free of exploitable option priors, this open-ended gain directly confirms genuine visual grounding over format memorization.

blocks.en: Against the distillation baselines, crop-based teachers such as Vision-OPD and VAD, as well as evidence-guided EAD and S-OPD, fall behind SFT at both scales. In wide aerial scenes, tight target crops discard the external spatial references needed to resolve ambiguity (Figure 1 ), while generic evidence alignment in EAD and two-sided contrast in S-OPD struggle without full-scene reference anchors and decoupled target masking. By marking target and reference regions directly within the full scene and isolating target-only interventions, GeOPD preserves global layout cues and outperforms EAD and S-OPD by 4.16 and 3.76 points at 4B, with 2.79 and 2.37 points at 9B, while surpassing multi-scale RS-OPSD by 1.59 points at 4B and RP-OPSD by 1.30 points at 9B.

The airplane’s position relative to that vehicle provides evidence for the answer. We compare the initial and trained 4B student by rescoring the trained student’s response at fixed prefixes. blocks.en: Evidence masking and correction weights. On held-out questions, GeOPD-4B’s reference answer scores drop substantially more under target masking than under matched unrelated masking across all thresholds while spatial references remain visible (Figure 5 (a)), and occluding spatial references alone on relational items similarly causes a sharp drop, confirming reliance on both scene elements (Appendix E ). During training, GeOPD upweights teacher corrections aligned with the student’s distributional shift under target restoration. Within a full response, only a fraction of tokens directly encodes target attributes or spatial relations, whereas remaining tokens form syntactic structure or refer to unoccluded landmarks. Consequently, the trajectory-averaged weights in Figure 5 (b) remain stable at a selective level throughout training for both backbones, showing that directional selection consistently filters out unaligned or syntactic tokens while focusing supervision on visually decisive tokens such as directly in Figure 4 .

blocks.en: Transfer across tasks. Comparing GeOPD against the Original + answer baseline in Figure 5 (c) reveals how grounded visual supervision reshapes downstream capabilities compared to direct answer privilege. Supervision from marked scenes and visual facts substantially strengthens tasks that require inspecting fine-grained attributes within bounded regions, including object counting, color recognition across open and closed formats, and post-disaster damage assessment. Conversely, providing the raw reference answer retains a slight shortcut advantage on abstract situation inference or canonical orientation tasks that rely more on semantic priors than local visual contrast. Overall, grounding the teacher in scene evidence yields consistent net gains across all five benchmarks. Appendix E details the full subtask breakdowns and masking controls.
blocks.zh: 跨任务转移. 将GeOPD与图5(c)中的原始+答案基线相比较,可以看出与直接回答特权相比,基于视觉监督如何重塑下游能力。 对有标记的场景和视觉事实的监督,大大加强了需要检查受约束区域内精细的属性的任务,包括物体计数、不同开放和封闭格式的颜色识别以及灾后损害评估。 反之,提供原始的参考答案保留了抽象情况推论或教义取向任务的轻微捷径优势,这些任务更多地依赖于语义前缀而不是局部视觉对比. 总体而言,将教师作为现场证据,在所有5个基准中产生持续的净收益。 附 录 E详细介绍了全部子任务分解和面具控制.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we investigate how contextual evidence supports remote sensing scene understanding. To advance this task, we introduce GeoContext-5K, a training dataset that links questions and answers to spatial cues, visual facts, and supporting regions. Building on these annotations, we propose GeOPD to distill guidance from a frozen teacher that sees the marked full image and a visual fact. The method prioritizes corrections aligned with the student’s response to restored evidence and weights contrast between the student’s original and masked scores by the teacher’s sensitivity to masking. Across five remote sensing VQA benchmarks, GeOPD surpasses the evaluated open-weight MLLM baselines in mean score and leads the post-training comparison at each backbone size. At inference, the student answers from the original image and question alone. We hope this work encourages the use of contextual evidence as supervision across remote sensing tasks.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们调查背景证据如何支持遥感场景的理解. 为了推进这项任务,我们引入了GeoContext-5K,这是一个将问答与空间提示,视觉事实以及辅助区域相连接的培训数据集. 基于这些说明,我们提议GeOPD从一个冷冻的老师那里分解出指导,他看到了被标记的完整图像和视觉事实. 该方法优先考虑与学生对已恢复的证据的反应相适应的校正,以及老师对遮掩的敏感性对学生原始分和被遮掩分的对比. 在五个遥感VQA基准中,GeOPD以平均分数超过评估的开放重量的MLLM基线,并领导每个主干规模的培训后比较。 推想,学生只从原始形象和提问中回答. 我们希望这项工作鼓励利用背景证据作为遥感任务的监督。

blocks.en: B.1 Configuration and Inference

blocks.en: Training. We initialize the student and frozen teacher from the same Qwen3.5-4B or Qwen3.5-9B checkpoint [ 30 ] . Both GeOPD runs use a batch of 96 questions, four sampled responses per question, and 56 updates over one epoch at a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} . They use four NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs, FSDP, BF16 computation with FP32 actor parameters, gradient clipping at 1.0, and weight decay of 0.01. Rollout tensor parallelism is one at 4B and two at 9B. The 4B actor uses a microbatch of one per GPU and no learning rate warmup.
blocks.zh: 培训。 我们从同一个Quen3.5-4B或Quen3.5-9B检查站 初始化学生和被冻结的教师[30]. 两个GeOPD运行使用批96个问题,每个问题4个抽样答复,一个时代的56个更新,学习率为2×10−6 2\times 10×6}. 它们使用4个NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU,FSDP,BF16用FP32演员参数计算,梯度剪接为1.0,重量衰减为0.01. 推出的收音机平行式为一等于4B,二等于9B. 4B演员采用每GPU一分一分的微分,没有学习率热身.

blocks.en: Objective implementation. Directional distillation computes JS with a mixture coefficient of 0.5 on the 100 student tokens with the largest original-image probability and a residual bucket. The inverse-probability floor is 10 − 8 10^{-8} , and direction comparisons with a norm product below 10 − 8 10^{-8} receive zero weight. Rollout importance correction uses a weight cap of 2. The original and masked views share the question, image dimensions, and multimodal positional layout. The masked score and the teacher passes are detached.

blocks.en: Baseline adaptations. Vision-OPD uses a support crop and an EMA teacher. RP-OPSD halves the student’s image dimensions while preserving the teacher view and uses bias-corrected reverse KL over the teacher’s top 100 tokens. Their EMA update rate is 0.05. RS-OPSD combines global, expanded-context, and detailed views with a correctness-aligned objective, a teacher reliability probe, and a fixed KL reference. Short-answer reliability uses conservative greedy agreement with the canonical answer. GRPO uses the shared answer-equivalence rules and a reference KL coefficient of 0.001. VAD uses a fixed initial teacher, a positive budget of 0.8, and a nonvisual anchor of 0.1. The negative view reduces the support crop to 10% of its size before resizing it back, with the full search area preserved for global, absence, and counting questions. EAD and S-OPD follow their published visual-alignment and cross-view contrast objectives on the same annotations. SFT uses FP32 parameters, BF16 computation, and one normalization over the accumulated batch of reference answers.
